name: marina-night-flash-portrait
image_purpose: marina environment, direct flash, and nighttime outfit reference

prompt.project_info: Create a raw high-fidelity marina portrait of an approved adult woman in a non-sexualized crouched pose.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with long sleek hair, natural facial texture, glossy pink lips, light gray rib-knit modest long-sleeve dress, gray opaque tights, dark slate knee-high boots, crossbody strap, pendant, and bracelets.
prompt.composition_elements: High-angle medium shot with subject occupying about 65% of frame, crouching on textured stone tile, dark marina water and dock reflections behind, a white yacht in the distance, and realistic shadow anchoring.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Harsh direct flash around 6500K, bright highlights and deep shadows, moody urban waterfront nighttime atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone photography, portrait 9:16, 24mm wide-angle, sharp subject focus, authentic digital grain, no artificial bokeh.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Approved adult woman with long sleek hair crouches comfortably on stone tiles at a nighttime marina, wearing a modest light-gray rib-knit long-sleeve dress, opaque tights, dark knee-high boots, crossbody strap, pendant, and bracelets. Use high-angle 24mm smartphone flash, dark water, dock reflections, distant yacht, sharp realistic background, and digital grain. No lace thigh-highs or voyeuristic framing.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, lace thigh-highs, exposed garter, deep neckline, lingerie, transparent clothing, sexualized crouch, voyeuristic framing, distorted anatomy, artificial bokeh, watermark, logo invention, public figure likeness.
